subject: AAA-022:W2-SCHEDULE-READERS-IMPLEMENT successor scope and acceptance design

reviewed_design.api: Add effect-owned synchronous SessionProjectionRegistry.onBeforePrepareSession(listener), invoked after structural baseline validation and before projection folds/cells/feed installation, passing the exact SessionPreparation.
reviewed_design.schedule: Fold the Schedule definition over the preparation baseline and subscribe its pre-append validator to the same preparation feed. Convert ScheduleLogError only to the captured Schedule InvariantError; retain direct session/created preflight and post-initialization state checks.
reviewed_design.lifecycle: Disposing the hook registration prevents later hook calls. A consumer already attached to one SessionPreparation remains owned by that feed until seal/dispose. AgentLoop rollback disposes preparations; direct callers must dispose before retry after a failed preparation.
reviewed_design.append_semantics: A rejected new append leaves Session sequence and validator state unchanged so a valid same-sequence retry can succeed. Existing accepted suffix events replay in order; failed replay is distinguished because it cannot undo those already accepted unpublished events.
reviewed_design.release_data: No Session event or persisted format changes. Resume crash-repair events may already have been appended before Schedule validation, so tests must not promise rollback of those append-only repair events.
reviewed_design.projection_spec: Include the prior verification-only spec in implementation paths to repair missing SessionStore setup in two contexts and replace the invalid disappearance expectation after Schedule fiber disposal. The repository test invariant harness mounts a Schedule invariant owner, which may retain the shared projection after the Schedule feature fiber unloads; assert the actual registration disposer/lifetime.
reviewed_design.docs_and_generation: The Session Projection public service method requires the listed English/Chinese package and subsystem page pairs, pairing sidecars, and regenerated Cordis API catalog. No generator-source path is required.
reviewed_design.exclusions: No Session or AgentLoop source change is needed; no event schema, SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION, projection checkpoint schema, or persisted format change is included.

acceptance: Registry hook receives the exact preparation after structural checks and before cells/feed install; listener order, effect disposer, and failure cleanup are covered.
Schedule invalid create/resume baselines produce the package-owned InvariantError before publication while valid create, resume, and inherited-fork cuts work.
Invalid AgentSetup append is rejected before commit, leaves seq and validator state unchanged, and permits a valid append at the same sequence.
Accepted preparation suffix events replay in order; replay failure is tested separately from rejection of a future append.
The preparation-owned feed consumer is cleared on seal/disposal and is not retried without disposing the failed preparation.
Projection spec fixtures provide SessionStore and the effect test accounts for the automatic Schedule invariant owner.
All public API/docs/generated catalog changes remain inside the exact implementation path set; six prior consumers and three Schedule files remain read-only.
limitations: Read-only design/scope review. The reviewer ran no tests or generators and changed no repository files. The implementation-ready decision does not verify implementation or release readiness.
